objective: Characterize sensitivity of the CoDef/PairStart comparison to local perturbations of synthetic model attributes.
sampling_unit: The 60 fixed graph-seed instances in chinanet_main_50_20seed_runs.csv; no new topology samples.

perturbation.type: Independent deterministic multiplicative factors uniformly sampled on [0.85, 1.15] per instance and attribute.
perturbation.costs: All 12 initial/response action costs are multiplied by their condition-specific factors; budgets remain 4.0/4.0.
perturbation.effects: Only node-hardening and edge-restriction probabilities are multiplied; values are capped at 1.0. Node-isolation removes adjacent edges and its effect field is not used by the simulator, so isolation effects are held fixed.
perturbation.asset_values: Every non-ingress node asset value is multiplied by an independent factor; topology, critical labels, and edge risks stay fixed.
perturbation.seeds: Each factor stream is seeded by SHA-256 of experiment/family/primary-seed/condition/attribute.
perturbation.interpretation: A model-parameter sensitivity probe, not empirical uncertainty, calibration, or independent replication.

evaluator.constraints: At most one node-isolation action jointly across initial and response actions.

analysis: Descriptive paired deltas, lower/tied/higher counts, and within-method objective changes from base; no confirmatory p-values.
